DROP-CLUSTER.summary: Removes an entire cluster's metadata from FoundationDB.

oneOf.description: Without a token: a confirmation token valid for 60 seconds.
With a valid token: the cluster metadata was removed.

arguments.name: cluster-name
arguments.summary: Name of the cluster to drop. Must match the cluster name in the running node's configuration.

arguments.name: token
arguments.summary: Confirmation token returned by the first call. Required to execute the actual deletion.
